parsed.note_claim: The video shows US Air Force C-17 Globemaster IIIs airdropping aid, not Chinese planes.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: It was taken in October 2024 and included aid from the United States and France. The German armed forces also took part in this.
parsed.reason: The DW fact-check confirms the video shows aid from the United States (among others), not China, and explicitly states China did not airdrop aid into Gaza.
